title: yodel revert <env> <id> --json
description: Version 1. The revert of a migration: the statements that take the schema from its recorded schema back to its parent's (a hand-written revert step's first), the digest its gate binds, and what happened: planned (--dry-run), gated (waiting for approval), reverted, or failed. Within a version, fields are only added; a reader ignores fields it does not know.

to.description: The migration it goes back to; null when the first migration is reverted.

source.description: step: the hand-written revert step; reverse: diffed from the recorded schemas.

done.description: It succeeded in an earlier run of this revert and is not sent again.

dataSteps.description: The migration's data steps, which the hand-written revert step undoes.

approve.description: The chant approve command that approves this revert.
